as_told.title: SDI as backdoor for UAP programs

plain: A researcher who goes by UAPGerb, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, talks about SDI, the Strategic Defense Initiative, which was President Ronald Reagan's 1983 plan for a space-based missile shield. UAPGerb says it likely had a hidden back door to fund secret programmes on UAP, the government's term for unidentified objects in the sky, and even to act offensively against them. He gives it once as his own view and once as something unnamed sources told him. If true, it would mean a famous defence project secretly paid for work on, and against, unknown craft.
